value.signature: fn unopened_proposal_digest (proposal : & ProposalCommitment) -> Result < UnestablishedProposalDigest , EncodingError >

review.body: { if proposal . recipe != pn_act_profile :: PROPOSAL_RECIPE { return Err (EncodingError :: Recipe) ; } Ok (UnestablishedProposalDigest (proposal . bytes)) }
review.item_premise: Public body encodings and computed public commitments record all arguments and results. Secret openings remain owned carriers; only the existing profile recipe publishes its final residue. Unopened digests establish no proposal relation.
